Given your low CD4 count and symptoms, I need to rule out retinal detachment or opportunistic infections like CMV retinitis. Dilated Fundus Examination.

Once the exam is complete, please confirm if the spots appear as distinct gray or yellow "pizza and ketchup" lesions versus scattered hemorrhages, and clarify if you are experiencing any metamorphopsia, such as straight lines appearing wavy.

Based on your low CD4 count and the specific description of a painless, fixed "curtain" of vision loss, the clinical picture strongly suggests Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis. DIAGNOSIS READY: CMV Retinitis.
